title: Sell Mineral Rights in Westland, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Westland, PA | Washington County Buyer
metaDescription: Own minerals near Westland in Washington County? We evaluate Marcellus wet gas interests directly and pay cash when the numbers work for both sides.
heroLead: Westland is a small unincorporated community in Washington County, close enough to the Marcellus core that most parcels here were leased during the first wave of drilling.
intro: Small places like Westland rarely make oil and gas headlines, but the leasing activity moved through communities like this one just as fast as it moved through the bigger towns. If your family has held minerals here since before the boom, chances are the lease itself is older than the technology that eventually drilled it.
We buy interests in and around Westland the same way we'd want someone to buy ours: by actually reading the lease first.

sections.heading: Pre-Boom Leases, Post-Boom Production
paragraphs: A lot of ground around Westland was leased in the mid-2000s, before horizontal Marcellus drilling was common, on terms written for vertical wells that never got drilled that way. When operators came back years later with horizontal rigs and multi-well pads, some of those old leases got extended or amended rather than renegotiated.
That gap between when a lease was signed and when a well was actually drilled is exactly where outdated royalty terms tend to hide, and it's the first thing we check.

sections.heading: What We Look For in a Westland Interest
paragraphs: We confirm your net mineral acreage, the unit or units your tract is pooled into, and how production has trended on your royalty statements. Decline curves matter here; a well that came on strong in its first eighteen months and has since fallen off tells a different value story than one still holding steady output.
We're upfront that we look at recent activity, not old headlines, because a boom that happened a decade ago doesn't guarantee what your specific tract is producing now.

sections.heading: Handling Family Interests Split Across Heirs
paragraphs: It's common for a Westland-area interest to have started with one landowner and now be split among six or eight descendants, each holding a small fraction. We can work with individual heirs directly or coordinate a single closing that pays each owner separately according to their share, whichever is easier for your family.

faqs.question: Is Westland considered core Marcellus ground?
faqs.answer: It sits within Washington County's productive wet gas fairway, though the specific value of your tract depends heavily on your unit's production history, beyond the general location alone.

faqs.question: My lease was signed before the Marcellus boom even started. Does that matter?
faqs.answer: It can. Older leases sometimes carry royalty and deduction terms that were never updated when horizontal drilling arrived, which is one of the first things we review.

faqs.question: Can you buy just my share if my siblings and I inherited together?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly buy individual heir shares without requiring every co-owner to sell.
